objective: Build exhaustive provenance-aware reference acquisition for official physical, game and film minifigures.
key_findings: Physical catalog coverage is approximately 19.2k catalog records, not unique characters.
LEGO says it has produced over 200 game titles since 1995, so TT Games alone is insufficient.
TT Games local assets can provide textures/models/configs unavailable on public pages.
Film frames should be scene-sampled and deduplicated rather than treated as millions of equal samples.
LDraw patterned minifigure parts provide licensed community reconstructions useful for linework/geometry analysis.
Source-to-LEGO TranslationPair records are the highest-value supervision for learning faithful official-style character translation.
Rebrickable documents minifigures as special Set-like records with their own part inventories, so physical ingestion now resolves component-level image candidates where the bulk tables provide them.

Official film acquisition needs a verified title registry plus local high-information frame sampling; theatrical anchors are primary-verified while direct-to-video candidates remain staged until verified.

Legacy games have recoverable native assets: LEGO Island SI/WDB, LEGO Racers JAM/GDB, Rock Raiders LWO plus per-surface minifigure textures, LEGO Universe client formats, and broad TT archive/model/texture tooling.
A complete digital corpus must include official LEGO web/browser games, not only commercial releases; historical titles span $HTML, Java, Shockwave, Flash, Unity Web Player and HTML5.

Flashpoint can serve as a preservation/local-file locator, while JPEXS, ProjectorRays and UnityPy provide technology-specific asset extraction; archive presence alone does not prove official LEGO provenance.
BrickLink API can independently enrich minifigure and color-specific component image references after the Rebrickable bulk census.
LEGO building-instruction pages can provide official PDF references per set without blindly mirroring the entire instruction archive.

The commercial/dedicated game queue has been over-inclusive from 1995–2026 so PC, console, handheld and mobile releases cannot silently disappear; each candidate carries a standard-minifigure/separate-form/unknown classification and verification state.
A manual GitHub Actions workflow can now fetch Rebrickable's current daily bulk catalog and produce a validated compact physical-corpus census without storing the raw media/catalog outputs in Git.

Official-reference processing now has a complete downstream architecture: normalization, canonical ReferenceSets, auditable deterministic features, DINOv3 visual embeddings, SigLIP2 multimodal embeddings, and leakage-safe grouped splits.

The recommended model strategy is retrieval-first, then structured source-to-LEGO decision learning, then constrained flat-template generation; a single monolithic image fine-tune is explicitly discouraged.
Training/evaluation splits must be grouped by OutfitDesign (and harder character/theme/mask-family benchmarks) so duplicate renders, crops, and variants cannot leak across train and test.
ReferenceSets select the best available front/rear/side/component evidence by authority and quality while preserving alternates and explicit missing views.

ChatGPT image generation is now a standardized hosted control arm: every research generation should compile the same structured reference/identity/style/mask/constraint packet, log failures, and version prompt revisions instead of using ad-hoc prompting.
next_steps: Run the manual GitHub Actions physical census or the importer locally against current Rebrickable daily CSVs and record actual coverage counts.
Run current LDraw pattern indexing and crosswalk patterned heads/torsos/legs/headgear to official physical samples.
Materialize reviewed physical reference-image hosts into local content-addressed storage and run SHA/dHash/embedding deduplication.
Implement/benchmark Grounding DINO + SAM 2.1 (and alternatives) for automatic minifigure detection, segmentation, video tracking, component crops and view classification.
Populate canonical ReferenceSets and deterministic/embedding features for the physical corpus.
Complete primary verification and extraction-strategy assignment for the commercial + browser game census; begin with Skywalker Saga, LEGO Island, Rock Raiders, LEGO Racers and LEGO Universe.
Begin verified film frame extraction and state clustering for theatrical plus rights-holder-verified direct-to-video films.
Populate source-to-LEGO TranslationPairs for licensed characters, prioritizing exact film/comic/game appearance matches.
Freeze the first retrieval-only benchmark before any generative fine-tuning.
After the official baseline is statistically stable, score and admit only customs that expand the corpus without degrading official likeness.
